title: Array of Resources losing track of Original Owner when using 'Paste from clipboard'
body: ### Tested versions v4.5.beta5.official [c81fd6c51] ### System information Godot v4.5.beta5 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21025.1024) - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads) - 15.87 GiB memory ### Issue description If you have a node with an array of resources and copy it to an empty scene (i.e use the `Paste from clipboard` feature), the original owner will be swapped, meaning it won't be able to change its own resources or even change its properties. The duplicate however, will be able to. To explain it better, here's the before and after copying from clipboard: #### Before #### After (Options bellow are grayed out and you can't change it anymore, imagine keyboard smashing sound Plzzzz) ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61c9641c-d221-4353-ba68-f8845db4bd38) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a Resource 2. Create a Node and create an Array of those custom Resources for it 3. Copy and paste Node to original scene 4. Save ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [res-clipboard.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21820499/res-clipboard.zip)
